article.content: It’s been eight years since the character last spoke. ‘It truly IS his homecoming,’ Malhotra says After years of silent appearances, The Simpsons has given longstanding character Apu Nahasapeemapetilon a new voice. American actor Sunil Malhotra, who moved to the US from India as a child, made his first appearance on the animated TV show as Apu on Sunday night. Continue reading...
